exposure: HbA1c at term just prior to delivery
cohort: 1000 women at term whose deliveries were imminent
finding: Raised HbA1c level at term births in the general pregnant population was independently predictive of Cesarean delivery after adjustment for potential confounders including diabetes in pregnancy.
mod_finding: After adjusting for confounders, a raised HbA1c level at term births in the general pregnant population is independently predictive of Cesarean delivery.
